gloss: day by day; with each passing day

definitions.gloss: day by day; with each passing day
definitions.explanation: Describes a change that is noticeable from one day to the next, getting steadily stronger, weaker, warmer and so on.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}に{日|ひ}に⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's getting warmer day by day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日|ひ}に{日|ひ}に⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The baby is getting bigger every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}して→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日|ひ}に{日|ひ}に⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}している→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: Since going into hospital, my grandfather has been recovering his strength day by day.

notes:
Used with verbs of change: ～くなる, ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧, ⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧, ⟦{弱|よわ}まる→弱まる：02330_yowamaru⟧ and the like.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧: gradually; the general word, for change at any pace
- {日増|ひま}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: day by day; a more written synonym, mostly for things that grow (⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日増|ひま}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧)
- ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: every day; says how often, not that something changes
